To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
“A combination of Transcriptional Regulation and microRNA Regulation improves the Stability of the Ratio of two Target Genes”.
a combination of transcriptional and microRNA regulation improves the stability of the relative concentration of target genes.
“The relative concentration of a TF and one of its target is precisely regulated by a miRNA.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the interplay between transcriptional regulation and microRNA mediated gene regulation.

the analysis of the regulatory networks in which the relative concentrations of target genes are kept at a desired value by the combination of a direct transcriptional regulation with a competition for microRNA binding.
the study of a new type of FFLs which combines transcriptional and microRNA regulation and which is characterized by the presence of a master regulator.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the combination of transcriptional and microRNA regulation improves the stability of the relative concentrations of target genes.
the combination of transcriptional and miRNA regulation allows a precise control of the concentration of a target gene in the cell.
the combination of the transcriptional regulation with the microRNA regulation improves the stability of the relative concentrations of target genes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in the presence of a TF, the miRNA can act as a “master regulator” of the relative concentration of its targets.
microRNA can be used as a tool to fine tune the concentration of a target gene and that the combination with a transcriptional regulation can be used to improve the stability of the ratio target/TF.
the combination of transcriptional and post-transcriptional regulation improves the stability of the ratio between the relative concentrations of target genes.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the combination of the transcriptional and microRNA regulation is a powerful mechanism to ensure that, in spite of the environmental noise, the relative concentrations of the target genes are precisely kept at the desired values.
the interplay between transcriptional and microRNA regulation allows to improve the robustness of the system by ensuring the stability of the relative concentrations of target genes.
microRNA regulation can play a role in the stability of the regulatory circuits in addition to the classical function of gene expression regulation.
